translated_title: Sheinbaum Expresses Her Joy Over Lula's Electoral Triumph in Brazil; “It Is a Breath of Fresh Air for Latin America”
original_title: Sheinbaum expresa su alegría por el triunfo de Lula en Brasil; "es una bocanada de aire fresco para América Latina"
author: Alonso Urrutia and Lilian Hernández
meta_description: Lula came back after losing the first round to Flavio Bolsonaro, and Sheinbaum opened her morning press conference flashing his trademark sign.
